caption: The drawing depicts a formal garden layout viewed from above, with a detailed inset of a house at the top and an inset of a gated entrance at the bottom right. In the main composition, a path begins at a black iron gate flanked by a white fence and two small conical trees and proceeds straight through a green lawn dotted with evenly spaced trees. The path passes a circular, multicolored flower bed with concentric rings in red, pink, yellow, green, and blue. The path continues up a few steps to a rectangular platform, again bordered by conical trees, leading directly to the main entrance of a large, two-story house depicted in pale beige and light brown with blue windows, a central gable, and a wraparound porch. In front of the house is another circular flower bed with a red center and an outer yellow and blue ring, surrounded by more conical trees and lawns with light green shading. The bottom right corner inset shows a closer view of the wrought-iron gate, with pink flowers and green vines climbing two pillars under a lantern, matching the gate at the garden's entrance. The entire drawing is rendered in colored pencils, using soft greens for grass and trees, with accent colors for flowers and house details.
title: Wood Residence
